questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence that uses inversion appropriately to emphasize the adverbial phrase.

Adverbial phrase: Only after the presentation did she realize the error in her report.

Which sentence correctly inverts the structure to emphasize this adverbial phrase?
options: Only after the presentation did she realize the error in her report.
After the presentation only did she realize the error in her report.
Only after the presentation she realized the error in her report.
After the presentation only she realized the error in her report.
questions.answer: Only after the presentation did she realize the error in her report.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the discovery?
options: It was the bright red car that caused the accident.
The bright red car was what caused the accident.
The accident was caused by the bright red car.
Causing the accident was the bright red car.
questions.answer: It was the bright red car that caused the accident.

questions.question: Select the correct sentence that appropriately uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation that contradicts reality.
options: If I were you, I would accept the offer immediately.
If I was you, I would accept the offer immediately.
If I had been you, I would have accepted the offer immediately.
If I had been you, I would accept the offer immediately.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would accept the offer immediately.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs ellipsis to maintain grammatical coherence in the context of the given scenario?
options: The team completed the project yesterday, whereas the other group had not finished it by the deadline.
The team completed the project yesterday, the other group had not finished it by the deadline.
The team completed the project yesterday, the other group not finishing it by the deadline.
The team completed the project yesterday, the other group not having finished it by the deadline.
questions.answer: The team completed the project yesterday, the other group had not finished it by the deadline.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses a complex sentence structure with multiple clauses to convey a nuanced grammatical choice, ensuring clarity and formal register.
options: Although the research findings were inconclusive, the committee proceeded with caution.
Although the research findings inconclusive, the committee proceeded with caution.
The committee proceeded with caution although the research findings were inconclusive.
The committee proceeded with caution, although the research findings inconclusive.
questions.answer: Although the research findings were inconclusive, the committee proceeded with caution.
